correctness.rationale: For the explicit 12-vertex/18-edge Frucht graph, exhaustive face enumeration gives a dual with cardinality f-vector (1,12,66,30,1). A deterministic sequence of 30 independently checked simplicial free-face collapses leaves a connected 12-vertex, 37-edge graph, homotopy equivalent to a wedge of 26 circles. Integral combinatorial Alexander duality gives rank-26 reduced \(H_8\) of the ordinary cut complex and zero elsewhere. Its complete six-skeleton gives five-connectivity, then Hurewicz and Whitehead upgrade to the exact 26-fold \(S^8\) homotopy wedge. An independent mod-two chain-rank calculation verifies the degree-eight rank and all other Betti vanish. Standalone verifier and literal output are in the package.

value.rationale: This is a complete integral homotopy classification of the ordinary 3-cut complex of the Frucht graph, the canonical smallest asymmetric cubic graph. Its three triangles plus one square violate both the triangle-free and the square-free three-cut classification hypotheses; the isolated four-cycle contributes a nontrivial extra homotopy sphere compared with the out-of-domain four-cycle-free numerical expression. The full simple-homotopy proof is reproducible and the exact object has a motivated structural boundary role rather than an arbitrary slice. No general theorem beyond this natural instance is asserted.
